TimeFieldRoot.description: Holds the field's time and shares it with the parts inside it: a `role="group"`, named by its `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or an enclosing FieldLabel. With a `name`, or inside a FieldRoot, it also renders a hidden `<input type="time">` that submits the value and whose native `min`, `max` and `required` checks Field reads.

props.value: The time, a `Temporal.PlainTime`. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the field; `null` is controlled and empty, and leaving it out (or `undefined`) lets the field hold its own value. A value set from outside replaces a partial edit. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.
props.defaultValue: The time at first, when the field isn't controlled. A form reset puts it back.
props.onValueChange: Called with the time whenever every segment is filled, and with `undefined` when a complete time becomes incomplete. It is called in a change of its own, so it may save or write something a loading question reads without holding the field.
props.min: The earliest valid time. An earlier one is kept, not clamped: the field is invalid and the hidden input reports `rangeUnderflow`.
props.max: The latest valid time. A later one is kept, not clamped: the field is invalid and the hidden input reports `rangeOverflow`.
props.locale: The locale whose segment order, separators, digits and segment names the field uses, with its day period names and hour cycle.
props.placeholderValue: The time an empty segment starts from when it is stepped with the arrow keys.
props.disabled: Whether the field can't be focused or changed. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot. A field disabled while a segment has focus gives focus back to that segment when it is enabled again.
props.readOnly: Whether the segments can be focused but not changed. `readOnly={pending? setting}` locks the field while a save is out without losing focus.
props.required: Whether a time is needed for the form to be valid.
props.name: The name the hidden input submits the value under (`13:45`, or `13:45:00` with `granularity="second"`); nothing is submitted while the field is incomplete. Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.
props.form: The id of a `<form>` the hidden input belongs to, when the field isn't inside it.
props.emptyText: What an empty segment's `aria-valuetext` says, in the app's language.
props.incompleteMessage: The validation message while some segments are filled and others not.
props.granularity: The smallest segment: `"hour"`, `"minute"` or `"second"`. Finer units of the value are 0.
props.hourCycle: `12` or `24` overrides the locale's hour cycle.
props.invalid: Marks the field invalid from outside: each segment gets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`, as from an invalid FieldRoot. For a composition that keeps the Field to itself (a picker). Given, it wins over the Field's state; a time outside `min`/`max` is invalid either way.
props.describedBy: Space-separated ids of what describes the field (a description, an error), given to each segment as `aria-describedby`, as an enclosing FieldRoot's would be. Given, it wins over the Field's.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the field is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the field is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the field is required.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Present when the time is outside `min`/`max`, when `invalid` is given true, or (without `invalid`) when the FieldRoot around it is invalid: missing, partly filled, or failing `validate`.
dataAttributes.data-focused: Present while one of the field's segments has focus.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once a segment has been focused and the field left.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the value has changed.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has a value.

TimeFieldSegment.description: One entry of the context's `segments`, rendered with `for segment in c.segments` in a component inside the root. An editable segment is a contenteditable `role="spinbutton"` with its value, range and name; a separator is an `aria-hidden` span. It renders `segment.text` as its content.

props.segment: The entry it renders. Keyed by kind (separators by position), so a segment's element stays the same as its value changes and keeps focus.

dataAttributes.data-type: The segment's kind: `hour`, `minute`, `second` or `dayPeriod`, or `literal` for a separator.
dataAttributes.data-placeholder: Present on an editable segment while it is empty (it then shows dashes).
